item.title: Two missing bollards, next to speedbumps, 21st November
item.description:
There are two bollards on Richmer Road, Slade Green, that have been hit and removed, these were placed inline with the speed bumps on the road. Now that they're missing, drivers are choosing to drive along the pavement (and at speed) to avoid the speed bumps, which is obviously very dangerous! The bollards need replacing as quickly as possible, I've had a couple of close calls while walking or running along that road. It looks like they were some sort of composite plastic, but as they're clearly easily damaged, maybe something more robust is required. Thank you.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Slade Green Road, Slade Green, Greater London

item.title: Enfield council discrimination, 21st November
item.description:
For years Enfield council refused to clean Bourne hill because I complained it was filthy. It is the busiest road in Winchmore Hill and Southgate and not ckeaner weekly and two particulars bins are never emptied in a council vengeful response to my complaints. The other bins are emptied. It is the busiest road in Winchmore Hill and Southgate and not ckeaner weekly and two particulars bins are never emptied in a council vengeful response to my complaints. The other bins are emptied. I have had time to clean the road over the past few weeks but this week rushed off my feet and it is consequently filthy full of waste. Last time this happened I pleaded for days for it to be cleaned and the council took a photo of a few centimetres of the road where there was no litter to show it had been cleaned when it had not. It still has not. The other revenge takes the form of online bullying and defamatory statements and lies which I had to ask my union and employer solicitors to deal with.
